item.title: Hanging clothes from tree branches, 20th August
item.description:
Tree 43 (pictured) has clothing and an umbrella hanging from the branches with fallen clothing immediate underneath it (pictured). Unnumbered tree near 43 (pictured) has 4 items of clothing underneath it. These items are obviously being taken by youths from outside the Greenwich & Bexley Hospice Charity shop on Bellegrove Road corner of Welling Way. People often deposit items outside the shop outside non-working hours. Items need removing from trees.

item.title: Cleansing request, 20th August
item.description:
Request for Urgent Cleaning and Maintenance of Public Area Dear Council Team, I am writing to report the poor condition of a public area near where I live and to ask if the Council could please arrange for it to be cleaned and maintained. As shown in the attached photographs, there is a significant amount of rubbish and discarded drink cans scattered underneath the bushes and around the seating area. The area appears to be regularly neglected, and it is becoming increasingly unpleasant to see this every day. I understand that keeping public spaces clean can be challenging, but it is disappointing that the area seems to receive attention only when residents clean it themselves or make a report. Residents should not have to repeatedly clean up public areas in order for them to be maintained. This is a place that local people use and pass by every day, and the current condition makes the area feel forgotten and uncared for. It is also concerning that rubbish is being left around the bushes and seating, which could attract pests and create an unpleasant environment. I would be very grateful if the Council could: Arrange for the rubbish and discarded cans to be removed. Clean the area around the benches and bushes and area around Alford Road ,the stairs and green space next to bus stop. Check whether the area requires more regular cleaning or maintenance. Consider whether additional measures are needed to prevent the area from becoming repeatedly littered. I am reporting this because I would like to see the area properly looked after and made pleasant and safe for everyone who lives nearby and uses the space. I hope the Council can please look into this and arrange a clean-up as soon as possible. Thank you for your attention. I look forward to hearing from you regarding what action can be taken. Kind regards,
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 2-6, Hawthorn Place, Northumberland Heath, Erith, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
